frases.dice: A seventy billion parameter model in sixteen-bit weighs one hundred forty gigabytes. To generate each token, you must read all of it.
frases.muestra: A 70-billion-parameter model in 16-bit weighs 140 GB. To generate each token, you must read all of it.
frases.es: Un modelo de 70.000 millones en 16 bits pesa 140 GB. Para generar cada token, hay que leerlos todos.

frases.dice: On an H one hundred, that takes at least forty-two milliseconds: generation is limited by memory, not compute.
frases.muestra: On an H100, that takes at least 42 ms: generation is limited by memory, not compute.
frases.es: En una H100, eso toma al menos 42 ms: generar está limitado por la memoria, no por el cómputo.

frases.dice: Tech capsule: the physics of inference, and quantization.
frases.muestra: Tech capsule: the physics of inference and quantization.
frases.es: Cápsula técnica: la física de la inferencia y la cuantización.

frases.dice: With a batch of one, each parameter does two operations for every two bytes read: one operation per byte. The G P U needs about three hundred.
frases.muestra: With a batch of 1, each parameter does 2 operations for every 2 bytes read: 1 operation per byte. The GPU needs about 300.
frases.es: Con un lote de 1, cada parámetro hace 2 operaciones por cada 2 bytes leídos: 1 operación por byte. La GPU necesita cerca de 300.

frases.dice: That is why requests are batched: one read of the weights serves the whole batch. But the K V cache grows: thirty-two users with four thousand tokens take forty gigabytes.
frases.muestra: That is why requests are batched: one read of the weights serves the whole batch. But the KV cache grows: 32 users with 4,096 tokens take 40 GiB.
frases.es: Por eso se agrupan pedidos: una lectura de pesos sirve a todo el lote. Pero la caché KV crece: 32 usuarios con 4.096 tokens ocupan 40 GiB.

frases.dice: Quantizing means storing the weights with fewer bits. Divide by a scale, round to integers, and multiply back when you use them.
frases.muestra: Quantizing means storing the weights with fewer bits. Divide by a scale, round to integers, and multiply back when you use them.
frases.es: Cuantizar es guardar los pesos con menos bits. Divides por una escala, redondeas a enteros y al usarlos multiplicas de vuelta.

frases.dice: The rounding error has variance delta squared over twelve. In four bits, the model drops from one forty to thirty-five gigabytes: four times less to read.
frases.muestra: The rounding error has variance Δ²/12. In 4 bits, the model drops from 140 to 35 GB: 4× less to read.
frases.es: El error de redondeo tiene varianza Δ²/12. En 4 bits, el modelo pasa de 140 a 35 GB: 4 veces menos que leer.

frases.dice: The problem is outliers: a few huge dimensions that ruin the scale for all the others.
frases.muestra: The problem is outliers: a few huge dimensions that ruin the scale for all the others.
frases.es: El problema son los valores atípicos: unas pocas dimensiones enormes que arruinan la escala de todas las demás.

frases.dice: G P T Q compensates each weight's error with second-order information. A W Q protects the one percent most important weights, based on activation size.
frases.muestra: GPTQ compensates each weight's error with second-order information. AWQ protects the 1% most important weights, based on activation size.
frases.es: GPTQ compensa el error de cada peso con información de segundo orden. AWQ protege el 1 % de pesos más importantes, según el tamaño de las activaciones.

frases.dice: Speculative decoding uses a small model that drafts several tokens, and the big one verifies them all in a single pass.
frases.muestra: Speculative decoding uses a small model that drafts several tokens, and the big one verifies them all in a single pass.
frases.es: La decodificación especulativa usa un modelo pequeño que propone varios tokens, y el grande los verifica todos en una sola pasada.

frases.dice: It accepts each one with probability min of one and p over q: the output has exactly the same distribution. With eighty percent acceptance and four drafts, it gets three point four tokens per pass.
frases.muestra: It accepts each one with probability min(1, p/q): the output has exactly the same distribution. With 80% acceptance and 4 drafts, it gets 3.4 tokens per pass.
frases.es: Acepta cada uno con probabilidad min(1, p/q): la salida tiene exactamente la misma distribución. Con 80 % de aceptación y 4 borradores, saca 3,4 tokens por pasada.

frases.dice: Position is encoded by rotation: Rope turns each pair of dimensions by the position, and the dot product depends only on the distance between tokens.
frases.muestra: Position is encoded by rotation: RoPE turns each pair of dimensions by the position, and the dot product depends only on the distance between tokens.
frases.es: La posición se codifica rotando: RoPE gira cada par de dimensiones según la posición, y el producto punto solo depende de la distancia entre tokens.

frases.dice: To extend the context, positions are interpolated: dividing them by sixteen takes a model from two thousand to thirty-two thousand tokens, with little fine-tuning.
frases.muestra: To extend the context, positions are interpolated: dividing them by 16 takes a model from 2,048 to 32,768 tokens, with little fine-tuning.
frases.es: Para alargar el contexto se interpolan las posiciones: dividirlas por 16 lleva un modelo de 2.048 a 32.768 tokens, con poco ajuste.

frases.dice: A curious finding: models pour a lot of attention onto the first tokens, even when they mean nothing. They are attention sinks.
frases.muestra: A curious finding: models pour a lot of attention onto the first tokens, even when they mean nothing. They are attention sinks.
frases.es: Un hallazgo curioso: los modelos vuelcan mucha atención en los primeros tokens, aunque no signifiquen nada. Son sumideros de atención.

frases.dice: If you keep those four tokens plus a recent window, the model handles streams of four million tokens stably.
frases.muestra: If you keep those 4 tokens plus a recent window, the model handles streams of 4 million tokens stably.
frases.es: Si guardas esos 4 tokens más una ventana reciente, el modelo procesa flujos de 4 millones de tokens de forma estable.

frases.dice: On Google Cloud, JetStream serves models on T P Us with int eight quantization of weights, activations and cache. On G P Us, G K E runs v L L M with A W Q or G P T Q models.
frases.muestra: On Google Cloud, JetStream serves models on TPUs with int8 quantization of weights, activations and cache. On GPUs, GKE runs vLLM with AWQ or GPTQ models.
frases.es: En Google Cloud, JetStream sirve modelos en TPUs con cuantización int8 de pesos, activaciones y caché. En GPUs, GKE corre vLLM con modelos AWQ o GPTQ.

frases.dice: The basics: memory bandwidth, quantization error, rejection sampling, and rotations.
frases.muestra: The basics: memory bandwidth, quantization error, rejection sampling and rotations.
frases.es: Las bases: ancho de banda de memoria, error de cuantización, muestreo por rechazo y rotaciones.
